title: Microphone Emoji: Copy & Paste 🎤 — Meaning, History & Every Way to Type It
meta_description: Copy and paste the microphone emoji 🎤 (U+1F3A4) — what it means, its 2010 Unicode history, and how it differs from the studio microphone 🎙️. Click to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: The handheld mic you reach for to talk about singing, karaoke, MC-ing, interviews, and mic-drop moments — not to be confused with the tripod-mounted studio microphone 🎙️. Click to copy it instantly.
intro: The microphone emoji (🎤, U+1F3A4 MICROPHONE) depicts a handheld mic with its head angled toward the mouth — the shape used for singing, karaoke, hosting, interviews, stand-up, and mic-drop moments. It's been part of the standard emoji set since Unicode 6.0 in 2010, among the first wave of emoji folded in from Japanese mobile carrier fonts, and it renders in full color on every major platform without needing a variation selector. Click it below to copy it instantly.
